description.en: Send a system notification when the main session finishes while the page is not focused.
description.zh: 主会话完成且页面不在前台时发送系统通知，可选手动提示音，开关持久化。

description.en: Register CodeGraph and Context7 MCP servers over stdio.
description.zh: 通过 stdio 注册 CodeGraph、Context7 两个 MCP server。

description.en: Switchable Tavily / model-native web search, with a switch back to DSH's built-in search.
description.zh: 可切换 Tavily / 模型自带联网搜索，一键交回 DSH 内置搜索。

description.en: Notes the agent keeps across sessions, with automatic dreaming that corrects and compacts them.
description.zh: 让 agent 跨会话记住教训与做法，并在会话结束后自动整理记忆。

description.en: List installed plugin versions, check Git and npm sources, and update live from Settings.
description.zh: 在设置页列出版本、检查 Git/npm 来源更新，并实时更新插件。
